descriptions.inProgress: Out of the blue, #rMaster Goblin#k decided to speak to me. Master Goblin seemed eager to dispell the rumors and misconceptions held towards him... is he for real?? I should head over to the #bRock Support of the Disappeared Statue#k at #bGoblin Forest 2#k as Master Goblin instructed.
descriptions.completed: Master Goblin reiterated he had no hard feelings towards Mu Lung, and that all this hatred stems from Do Gong, who's jealous of Master Goblin's mastery on spells. No way... I better talk to Master Goblin and find out myself.
